application_conditions: Application via the 'Affiliate Application' link, reviewed by Gemini. Named audiences: influencers / content creators / community leaders, Gemini users, organisations 'whose values align'. Other criteria not published.
paid_action: '$25 per converted account' when a new user 'places a trade'. The Gemini Credit Card is not named as a paid action; the credit-card referral terms explicitly exclude 'marketing affiliates' from the $50 cardholder referral offer.
validation_conditions: New user must place a trade. Window and other conditions not stated.

commission.model_note: Flat CPA: $25 per converted (trading) account. No card-specific payout found.

rules_note: Performance tracked "via the Impact platform". No programme terms document linked from the article (confirmed 2026-11-17). Cardholder-only Credit Card referral programme: $50 referrer / $50 referee, $250 bonus at the 5th referral within a rolling 12 months, max 50 referrals and $5,000 per calendar year; "Gemini Credit Card marketing affiliates, those who promote the Gemini Credit Card" are not eligible; each individual may earn under either the Credit Card or the Exchange referral programme, not both. Exchange Referral Rewards Program (page dated 2026-01-20, offer from 2025-11-24): Recruit tier only (Icon/Legend revenue-share tiers discontinued), $50 / €20 / AUD 50 to each side after the referee trades ≥ 100 within 30 days, paid at day 32, cap $1,500/€1,500/AUD 1,500 per referrer; influencers may ask for "a specialized influencer arrangement" via affiliates@gemini.com; the credit card is not included. A FlexOffers listing of a "Gemini CreditCard" programme ($110 on approval, US IPs) is marked "not currently offering" — third-party, discovery only.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated. The credit card itself is US-only.
